LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Yari.label: yari
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Yari.description:
The straight-bladed spear of the foot soldiers, long enough to keep a horseman at bay.
Requires 5 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Yumi.label: yumi
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Yumi.description:
The tall asymmetric bow of Yamato, gripped below its middle and drawn to the ear.
Requires 5 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Tatami.label: tatami and gravel gardens
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Tatami.description:
Lay woven straw tatami mats and rake white gravel into the patterns of still water.
Requires 5 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Kimono.label: kimono
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Kimono.description:
Sew the wrapped and belted robe worn by every class of Yamato.
Requires 5 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Onigiri.label: onigiri
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Onigiri.description:
Rice pressed into triangles and wrapped in seaweed: the travelling food of soldiers and pilgrims.
Requires 5 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Torii.label: torii gates
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Torii.description:
Raise the red gates that mark the passage from the everyday world into a sacred place.
Requires 5 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Levy.label: ashigaru levy
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Levy.description:
Every farmer keeps a spear by the door and knows where to run when the drum sounds.
Tradition: Colonists move 3% faster.
Requires 15 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Kyudo.label: kyudo
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Kyudo.description:
The way of the bow: a calm breath, a perfect posture and an arrow that is released rather than shot.
Tradition: Colonists gain +2 shooting accuracy.
Requires 20 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Zen.label: zen garden
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Zen.description:
Raking gravel around a few stones every morning teaches the mind to settle like the sand.
Tradition: Colonists' mental break threshold drops by 3%.
Requires 20 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Tamahagane.label: tamahagane steel
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Tamahagane.description:
Smelt jewel steel in a clay furnace and fold it again and again into blades with a soft spine and a hard edge.
Requires 10 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_TeaHouse.label: tea house
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_TeaHouse.description:
Build a low table for the tea ceremony and stone lanterns to light the garden path.
Requires 15 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Dojo.label: dojo
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Dojo.description:
A training hall with straw posts and racks for practice swords.
Requires 15 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Yoroi.label: yoroi armour
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Yoroi.description:
Lacquered lamellar armour laced with silk, and the horned kabuto helmet of the samurai.
Requires 25 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Ceremony.label: tea ceremony
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Ceremony.description:
Every movement of the host is fixed and unhurried. Guests leave lighter than they came.
Tradition: Colonists gain recreation 15% faster.
Requires 25 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Folds.label: forged folds
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Folds.description:
The smith's patience becomes the whole colony's habit: measure twice, strike once.
Tradition: Colonists do general labour (smithing, crafting, butchering, cutting stone) 10% faster.
Requires 30 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Bushido.label: bushido
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Bushido.description:
The way of the warrior: duty before life, calm before pain.
Tradition: Colonists gain +3 melee dodge chance and +5% pain shock threshold.
Requires 40 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_MasterCraft.label: master craft
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_MasterCraft.description:
A Yamato craftsman would rather make one perfect thing than ten good ones.
Tradition: Crafted items have a 12% chance to come out one quality level higher, but colonists work 5% slower.
Requires 45 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Mandate.label: mandate of heaven
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Mandate.description:
The rightful order is restored, and the people of Yamato work and study with calm hearts.
Tradition: Colonists learn 5% faster and their mental break threshold drops by 3%.
Requires 50 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
Unlocked by finishing the nation's story.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Tanegashima.label: tanegashima
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Tanegashima.description:
Matchlocks copied from a stranded merchant's gun and improved in the forges of Sakai until they outshot the original.
Requires 35 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Sakai.label: Sakai gunsmiths
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Sakai.description:
Three ranks of gunners, one firing, one ramming, one priming. Every man knows his breath and his count.
Tradition: Colonists aim 8% faster.
Requires 45 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Yagura.label: yagura
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Yagura.description:
Castle builders learn to raise arrow towers at the corners of the walls, where archers can shoot along them.
Requires 40 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_SteamArmy.label: Yamato steam army
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_SteamArmy.description:
Cartridges, rifled barrels and a uniform: the army Yamato raised when the factories came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Yamato has reached the Age of Steam.
Requires 45 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_ElectricArmy.label: Yamato electric army
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_ElectricArmy.description:
Machine-made arms, a steel helmet and a field uniform in drab: the army Yamato raised when the wires came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Yamato has reached the Electric Age.
Requires 60 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Works.label: Yamato works
LanguageData.HE_Yamato_Works.description:
The first electric works of Yamato: one machine the nation is proud of, built to its own taste.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once Yamato has reached the Electric Age.
Requires 50 Yamato knowledge unless this is your heritage.
